findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: emailable_get_account, emailable_verify_email, emailable_create_batch, emailable_get_batch · Private data: emailable_get_account, emailable_verify_email, emailable_create_batch · Public sink: emailable_get_account, emailable_verify_email, emailable_create_batch, emailable_get_batch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: emailable_get_account, emailable_verify_email, emailable_create_batch, emailable_get_batch · Private data: emailable_get_account, emailable_verify_email, emailable_create_batch · Public sink: emailable_get_account, emailable_verify_email, emailable_create_batch, emailable_get_batch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
